Nationally Recognized in Medical Aesthetics Founded in 2018 by board-certified Nurse Practitioners, Seaport Medspa is a medical aesthetics practice focused on safe, natural and balanced results. Our providers combine advanced aesthetic treatments, medical-grade skincare and an in-depth understanding of facial anatomy to help patients achieve their individual goals. ​ Seaport Medspa is nationally recognized as a Top 1% Galderma practice for Dysport, Restylane and Sculptra, and a Top 4% Allergan Aesthetics practice for Botox, Juvederm and DiamondGlow. This recognition reflects the experience of our team and the trust patients place in Seaport Medspa. ​ ​ Our providers are commission-free, keeping recommendations focused on what is appropriate for each patient rather than sales. Every complimentary consultation is with a provider, giving you time to understand options and what will make the most meaningful difference.​ our services CUSTOM TREATMENTS THAT MEET YOUR NEEDS Injectables Our injectable treatments include neuromodulators like Botox, Dysport, and Xeomin to relax targeted facial muscles and soften dynamic lines. We use hyaluronic acid-based fillers such as Restylane and Juvéderm to restore volume and enhance facial structure. We also offer biostimulators like Sculptra, which gradually stimulate collagen production for long-term improvement in skin support. BOOK NOW diamondGlow DiamondGlow is a non-invasive treatment that exfoliates, extracts debris, and infuses targeted serums—all in one step. It’s designed to improve texture, clarity, and hydration and can be performed on the face or body. Each treatment is customized to address concerns like dryness, discoloration, breakouts, or signs of aging. BOOK NOW BBL + Moxi BBL and Moxi are advanced light and laser treatments that can be performed separately or combined for enhanced results. BBL targets pigmentation and redness, while Moxi improves tone, texture, and early signs of aging. A consultation is required to determine the best treatment plan based on your skin goals. BOOK NOW Microneedling We offer SkinPen microneedling and Morpheus8 RF microneedling to stimulate collagen and improve texture, scarring, and skin laxity. Biologic boosters like PRF or Exosomes may be added to optimize healing. Please note: Morpheus8 requires an in-person consultation prior to treatment. SkinPen appointments can be booked directly online. BOOK NOW Chemical Peels We offer a range of medical-grade peels, including VI Peel, ZO Stimulator Peel, and BioRePeel. Each peel is selected based on your skin type, goals, and tolerance for downtime—helping to improve tone, texture, acne, and discoloration. From light exfoliation to deeper resurfacing, our providers will guide you to the right protocol. BOOK NOW Laser Hair Removal Laser hair removal offers a long-term solution for unwanted hair on the face or body using targeted light energy to reduce growth. Because skin type, hair color, and medical history affect treatment safety and efficacy, an initial consultation is required before beginning your treatment series. BOOK NOW EZGel/PRF Platelet-Rich Fibrin (PRF) is a regenerative treatment that uses your body’s own growth factors to stimulate collagen, improve skin quality, and support hair restoration. Common uses include under-eye rejuvenation, full-face PRF EZGel, and scalp injections for thinning hair. PRF is 100% natural making it an ideal biostimulant for skin and tissue repair. BOOK NOW Facials + Skincare Our customized facials support long-term skin health using medical-grade products and techniques tailored to your skin. Treatments may include dermaplaning, deep cleansing, exfoliation, and targeted serums. Your provider will also recommend a personalized at-home skincare routine using medical-grade products to help maintain and enhance your results. BOOK NOW Wellness Our injectable wellness support options include NAD+, B12, B Complex, Vitamin D3, Glutathione and many others. These intramuscular injections are designed to support energy, mood, immunity, metabolism, and cellular repair. Injections are administered by a licensed provider following a quick discussion of your health goals and preferences. BOOK NOW OUR PRODUCTS We use only authentic, medical-grade products and devices from trusted brands.​ Click a logo to see how it’s used at Seaport Medspa. See More Reviews Team THE FOUNDERS Medical First. Creatively Driven. As co-founders and board-certified Nurse Practitioners, Marielle Benayun and Elizabeth O’Neil have built Seaport Medspa around a medical-first approach to aesthetics. They develop and train every provider through established clinical protocols, advanced hands-on training and a strong foundation in anatomy, technique and patient safety. This approach extends across the entire team, bringing a consistent medical standard to advanced aesthetic treatments with a focus on natural, balanced results. CO-FOUNDER ​ Marielle Benayun, MSN, APRN, FNP-BC Marielle Benayun, a Family and Aesthetic Nurse Practitioner, holds degrees from Northeastern University and MGH Institute of Health Professions. Combining her background in psychology with experience in urgent care medicine, Mari approaches aesthetics with empathy, artistry, and science. Grateful for the chance to enhance lives through empowering beauty treatments, she thrives in her daily practice, dedicated to tangible improvements in her patients' well-being. FAVORITE Treatment: Facial Balancing CO-FOUNDER Elizabeth O’Neil, MSN, APRN, FNP-C Elizabeth O’Neil, a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner, holds advanced certifications in aesthetic medicine. Previously specializing in burn/trauma and surgical inpatient medicine at BWH, she recognized the psychological significance and potential in aesthetics. Elizabeth prioritizes ethical practices, ensuring her team is well-trained and transparent when serving patients. With a commitment to integrity, she delivers trusted care, emphasizing honesty and expertise.
